item.description: Jessica Stephens's mother Karon Evans has applied for court orders that would force the Northern Territory coroner to hold an inquest into her death in Kakadu National Park after being discharged from Royal Darwin Hospital in 2023.

item.title: ABC News: Residents fear there is no stopping $32b hyperscale data centre
item.description: Anthropic has already signed a deal to use a portion of the facility earmarked for the Western Downs, but it has not actually been approved yet

item.title: ABC News: Jane Doe threatened in Cornell University rape case, lawyer says
item.description: People have threatened to harm the woman identified as Jane Doe in the Cornell University case unless she withdraws her lawsuit, her lawyer says.

item.title: ABC News: Labuschagne set for Test after first ton in 11 months
item.description: Marnus Labuschagne makes his case to keep the number three spot in Friday's first Test against South Africa, with a timely century in a warm-up match.

item.title: ABC News: Roads, renewables and state taxes spark debate at Ripon election forum
item.description: Renewable energy transmission lines, the emergency services levy and roads were contentious topics at a candidates' forum in the marginal regional Victorian electorate of Ripon on Sunday.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Albanese heads to pre-COP in Fiji, Tuvalu
item.description: Anthony Albanese will attend a pre-COP meeting in Fiji and Tuvalu today with Climate Change Minister Chris Bowen. Follow live.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Wall Street closes higher after disappointing jobs report, ASX set to gain
item.description: Wall Street's key indices gained as rate rise expectations were wound back on soft jobs data. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

item.title: ABC News: Two pedestrians killed after being hit by car
item.description: Two men aged 70 and 55 have died after being hit by an SUV at Tura Beach, north of Merimbula, with the driver taken to hospital for mandatory testing.

item.title: ABC News: Showers bring 'awkward' end to long weekend across south-east Queensland
item.description: Rain and possible isolated severe storms are forecast for south-east Queensland as school resumes on Tuesday, while the northern coast stays mostly fine and the west remains hot.

item.title: ABC News: Former Bachelor star Sam Wood facing domestic violence charges
item.description: Fitness influencer and former Bachelor contestant Sam Wood is due to face court this morning on multiple domestic violence charges following his arrest in Noosa on the weekend.

item.title: ABC News: Almost half of Queenslanders don't believe police are honest, report finds
item.description: Data in the QPS's annual report has revealed the service failed to meet public integrity benchmarks including public trust, police honesty, and fairness by as much as 22 per cent.

item.title: ABC News: There are only six of these trees left in the wild. Conservationists are cloning them
item.description: The trees are estimated to be between 3,000 to 6,000 years old but they have no future without intervention.

item.title: ABC News: Short-stay operators have mixed reactions to SA's register proposal
item.description: The scheme is still being shaped but some operators are raising concerns about security and giving local governments control over land use and deciding rates.

item.title: ABC News: Push for review for victim-survivors after prosecution change to EMDR
item.description: A Sunshine Coast woman whose allegations of child abuse were not investigated by police because she had received a recommended trauma therapy is pushing for a review into how many alleged victim-survivors have faced the same barrier to justice.

item.title: ABC News: De Minaur fights back to reach China Open semis
item.description: Australia's Alex de Minaur pulls out a comeback win to reach the semifinals of the China Open in Beijing.

item.title: ABC News: Fire destroys prestige car workshop in Melbourne's north-west
item.description: Firefighters have battled for more than two hours to control a blaze inside a car workshop in Airport West early this morning.
